faq.q: What is Feria San Bernabé and when is it in 2029?
faq.a: Feria San Bernabé is Marbella’s biggest annual festival, honouring the city’s patron saint. In 2029 it runs from 7 to 12 June. Expect live music, flamenco, fairground rides, casetas (tents), and fireworks in the town centre and along the Paseo Marítimo.

faq.q: How do I get from Puerto Banús to the Feria?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is about 5 km (10 minutes by taxi, roughly €12–15) from Marbella’s old town and the Feria fairground. You can also take a local bus (line L-1) or walk along the beach promenade in 40 minutes.

faq.q: Can I anchor near the Feria fireworks display?
faq.a: Yes. The main firework show on 12 June is launched from the beach near the Feria site. Boats can anchor 200–300 m offshore for the best view. Our skippers know the safe anchorage spots and will position you for an unobstructed spectacle.
